mechanism: Albendazole may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism and potentially affect dapagliflozin exposure; dapagliflozin's glycosuric effect could theoretically worsen parasitic infection-related fluid/electrolyte disturbances.
action: Monitor renal function and glycemic control during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration status and electrolyte management, particularly if albendazole causes gastrointestinal side effects.
